full_track.tags: K-Indie folk pop. Acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note strumming pattern with occasional percussive slaps on the strings. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with single-note lines and light vibrato. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the chords in a simple rhythmic pattern. Drums consist of a soft kick drum on beats 1 and 3 with a brushed snare or light rimshot on 2 and 4. Male vocals are delivered in a warm, conversational baritone with light breathiness. The arrangement is sparse and intimate. Key of G Major. Tempo is 88 BPM.
